name: Draftline
description: Low-fi wireframe editor in the browser: screens, transitions and interactive preview on Blazor WebAssembly and .NET 10. Offline PWA, no backend.

paragraphs: Draftline is a standalone low-fi wireframe editor built with Blazor WebAssembly (.NET 10) and Flare. You sketch a screen out of schematic blocks without visual noise, link screens with transitions and click through the result. It runs entirely in the browser: no backend, no account, and the documents stay on your machine.
Demo: . It is an installable PWA that keeps working offline after the first visit.
features: Blocks: 57 kinds of block (forms, tables, trees, tabs, menus, charts, device frames, media, notes
and shapes) with editable text, data and states.
